proposal.title: Compile costs that still grow with the square of a stylesheet

body.p: (, perf-13; for the packets that own the files). With XSLT's component graph linear, at 2,048 template rules and 2,048 globals ('s N = 256) about 0.29 x 10^9 of 11.04 still grow four times per doubling: is_streamable_mode (src/xslt_streamability.c) walks every declaration for each template rule's modes (0.18); look_up_variable (src/xpath_lower.c) walks the declaration view for each variable reference (0.05); add_own_instances (src/xslt_package.c) and find_global (src/xslt_lower_control.c) search the instances or globals made so far for each declaration (0.05). Proposed default: a mode index made once for streamability, and the sorted name index of for the lowerer's variable lookup; the duplicate searches by a sort of the declarations when they show in a profile.
